recap.text: The host of Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem, the Maestro, pulls Zhang and Li Na's brother off the floor for a guessing game to buy lives. Li Na stays frozen between troglodytes and Brindled Vespas. Carl bets he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and the four of them walk out.

Li Na thanks Carl and the cat for saving her and her brother twice. She tells Carl to raise the cart a foot so the province boss's noodle attack hits the portal and goes to the abyss. Li Na refuses a high five because her touch causes excruciating pain and loss of bladder and bowel control. She brings a second vessel's torso and head, having used potions to heal the cuts.

Li Na sees ten hunters on the south side of town, including one in magical plate and one with a rifle. She identifies five mushroom guards and five more people in a Cold Stone Creamery. Li Na and Katia find an unconscious Eva under dead bugs. Li Na casts Preserve Injury on Eva, Katia cuts a ring from Eva's hand, and Li Na tells her brother to kill Eva.

Li Na and her brother hunt a dragon from Chinese myth in the Galaxy Soho building in Beijing. Li Na uses an upgraded robe to throw chains and a mystic card to cut draw time from ten seconds to five. Li Na and three other squads use Doggy Door upgrades from Lucia to meet at a church.

Mordecai brews a potion that allows Carl to recruit Li Na, whose squad builds defenses around Shanty Town. Li Na installs her brother's eye into her own face and uses a tower to run her aura into Club Vanquisher. After Eris casts spells that remove Florin and the 101st, Li Na builds a lattice of chains to stop a cat's paw. The System announces her strength and other stats at three hundred.

Zhang apologizes that it was Li Na's brother and not him. Li Na tells Zhang not to die and to keep his smile. She transfers people to the Pineapple Cabaret, and her Dread watches over them in the Garden of Deliverance.

beats.headline: Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem
beats.text: The show is Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem. The host calls himself the Maestro. He pulls my brother and Zhang off the floor and makes them play a guessing game for points that buy lives, and they will not choose which of us to spend them on. The rest of us stay frozen where we were standing, between the troglodytes and the Brindled Vespas. Then the crawler with the cat, Carl, decides he is too valuable to the production to be punished, and bets on it, out loud, and the four of us walk out. I am remembering his face.
beats.gist: The Maestro hosts Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem; Carl bets on himself and four people walk out.

beats.headline: Bait the boss through the hole
beats.text: Carl has saved my brother and me twice. I thank him, and the cat. Then I ask for the whole plan before we move, in case he dies and we must carry it on. Raise the cart a foot. Make the province boss on the other side of the noodle attack; it hits the portal and goes to the abyss. That gives us one more place to fall back to. He calls it fantastic. He offers a high five. If I touch someone with my hand, they feel excruciating pain throughout their body and lose control of bladder and bowels. I tell him so.
beats.gist: Li Na thanks Carl and the cat for saving her and her brother twice.

beats.headline: Easier to handle this way
beats.text: Carl goes into the trainyard behind a summoning. Katia and Elle draw the god away. The rest of us jump in front of the portal cart and come through the wall, and I bring the second vessel. Only the torso and head. I took off the lower body and the arms and healed him after each cut; it cost a few potions. The same idea as Carl's gnoll. He is easier to handle this way, and we can throw him into the portal instead of risking another accident. Carl should start punching.
beats.gist: Li Na brings a vessel's head and torso through a wall after removing the limbs.

beats.headline: Ten in the open, five in the pub
beats.text: Ten hunters on the south side of town, preparing to leave. One anti-air gun, spelled against targeting. Mostly level 50; one 53, one 63 in magical plate, possibly human. One rifle. Five mushroom guards. Maybe five more in the pub at the centre, Cold Stone Creamery. No sign of Vrah. My race sees who is bound to a god, and what god if I am close. The rifle carries the mark. I am not close enough to name it.
beats.gist: Li Na sees ten hunters on the south side of town and five guards in a pub.

beats.headline: Kill her
beats.text: I go with Katia. Eva is under the dead bugs, unconscious, almost out of health. I cast Preserve Injury so she cannot heal herself, and I point at the ring on her top right hand. Katia cuts it off. Eva wakes and asks to be healed. Katia laughs. My brother looks from Katia to me. Kill her, I say.
beats.gist: Li Na tells her brother to kill Eva after Katia cuts a ring from Eva's hand.

beats.headline: A dragon, and a faster draw
beats.text: Beijing. The Galaxy Soho building, with hundreds of crawlers in it. Imani asks whether Chris is still with us. He is. My robe has an upgrade, and my chain-throwing is better for it. My brother and I are hunting a dragon now. A real one, from Chinese myth. And I have a mystic card that cuts the draw time from ten seconds to five.
beats.gist: Li Na and her brother hunt a Chinese myth dragon in the Galaxy Soho building in Beijing.

beats.headline: Her squad reaches the church
beats.text: The church. Katia's squad is there, and Elle's, and Imani's, and mine. Four squads in one building, which does not happen by accident on this floor. It happened because Lucia handed round Doggy Door upgrades before she went down the stairs, and we used them. I take what I am given and I do not ask what it costs. That is the rule I made for this floor. I know what it says about me.
beats.gist: Li Na and three other squads use Doggy Door upgrades from Lucia to reach the church.

beats.headline: Recruited, at last
beats.text: Mordecai brews a potion that negates auras, and with it I can be recruited. I am. The moment it is done, I ask one thing: my squad builds the defences in and around Shanty Town. Carl agrees. The town is a ring around Larracos now, and it belongs to the Posse.
beats.gist: Mordecai brews an aura-negating potion so Carl can recruit Li Na and her squad for the Posse.

beats.headline: Did it work?
beats.text: A wire runs from my clock tower into Club Vanquisher, and my aura runs down it. Dark Purpose first. It is not meant to be used like this. It leveled faster than we anticipated, from four to fifteen, and I moved on. White chains are dragging the ghosts into the floor. Carl wants to know what that was, whether I knew, whether they are trapped somewhere. I ask him again. Did it work? Now I am using Defile Soul. Next I will train Bleeding Horror. I am cycling my dreads and leveling them all.
beats.gist: Li Na runs her aura from her clock tower into Club Vanquisher to use Dark Purpose.

beats.headline: I need to train
beats.text: Carl wants the first dread back on, and the cat shouts at me to do what he says. I will if I have to. I need to train, and I cannot give up this opportunity. When they extend their claws, they bleed, and that should be enough once the dread trains high enough. It is level five and rising. Carl is marked as an ally; the blood will not hurt him. I suggest the berserker plan. At the portal he warns me his tattoo spell will hurt. I am ready. Blood Horror is level fifteen. I turn on my last dread: Succulent Decay.
beats.gist: Li Na suggests the berserker plan and turns on Succulent Decay.

beats.headline: Everyone once a tattoo
beats.text: Eris casts Bear Witness, and most of Shanty Town is affected. Those of us inside structures are fine. My brother is with me. Zhang was outside. Florin and all of the 101st are affected. Anyone who was once a tattoo is unaffected. The sluggalos too. Then she casts Bring Forth the Witnesses, and everyone who froze rises into the air and is gone, and no long-range teleport works on this floor for an hour.
beats.gist: Eris casts Bear Witness and Bring Forth the Witnesses, removing Zhang, Florin, and the 101st.

beats.headline: My brother's eye
beats.text: Donut, do not break the ball apart. Donut asks where I am. I was installing my brother's eye into myself. I also stopped the mage who was going for Harpocrates. I am not strong enough yet to stop the god on my own. The deflector towers have paused him, and he will push past them to reach Donut. I suggest you run.
beats.gist: Li Na installs her brother's eye into herself and tells Donut to run.

beats.headline: Take it
beats.text: The front of my face is blood. I have gouged out my own eye and put my brother's in its place. Carl starts to say he is sorry. I stop him. I give him the potion he asked me to take off the dead war mage, or a copy of it: I used Jun's scroll of potion duplication. The original is for Harpocrates. Then I will save Zhang, Elle, Katia and the others before they too fall victim to your chaos. He says it could kill me. I go.
beats.gist: Li Na gouges out her eye to insert her brother's and gives Carl a duplicated potion.

beats.headline: All I can build
beats.text: The cat's paw hangs over Shanty Town, full of them. My chains go out from the tower. Dozens. Onto the wreckage around me, onto the Nest. A lattice. I tell the cat it is all I can build. Do it. She brings the paw down through it. The paw passes. They do not, until they do. Chains break. I grow more. She brings it down again. And again. Until the screaming stops.
beats.gist: Li Na builds a lattice of chains from a tower to the Nest and Shanty Town.

beats.headline: Three hundred, across the board
beats.text: The System announces my strength at three hundred. Then my intelligence. Then all of them, charisma included, and says it has no plan for this. Level eighty-seven. I marked every enemy in the ball before the paw came down. Several did not die. Both warlords among them. I go through the castle. The war mages open a portal and are gone. Carl asks how many got away. Several, I tell him, including both warlords. There are unaffiliated outworlders here too. Where did they come from?
beats.gist: The System announces Li Na has strength, intelligence, and charisma of three hundred at level eighty-seven.

beats.headline: I am no child to protect
beats.text: Zhang apologises that it was my brother and not him. There is nothing to apologise for. I am no child to protect. I never have been. He has been a good friend to me, and Jun loved him like a brother. I will do this. I will clear the way for everyone who comes after the next race, and I will make certain the war mages do not turn on us. Do not die, Zhang. Do not ever lose your smile. I used to smile at him so that he would smile back. I tell him so. Then I am ready.
beats.gist: Li Na tells Zhang she is no child to protect and asks him not to die.

beats.headline: The Garden of Deliverance
beats.text: It works. The transfer holds, and they come across to the Pineapple Cabaret one after another, and my Dread watches over each of them from the moment they arrive. They are calling it the Garden of Deliverance. I do not need to see them to know they are alive. The Dread tells me. It tells me everything, all the time, and it does not stop.
beats.gist: Li Na transfers Team Li Na to the Pineapple Cabaret, where her Dread watches over them.

relations.note: Marked with the Ring of Divine Suffering
